title: Single Number
summary: Return the only value that occurs once.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–30000 signed integers in [−30000,30000], with exactly one singleton and every other frequency two.

statement: Return the only value that occurs once. Every other value occurs twice.

examples.explanation: The unique value can be negative.
The sole element is the answer.

constraints: 1–30000 signed integers in [−30000,30000], with exactly one singleton and every other frequency two.
hints: Conceptual: Pairing identical values removes their influence.
Directional: XOR of a value with itself is zero.
Implementation: Fold XOR across the input using signed 32-bit words.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
